summary: Verified Suno music playback bug fix on public NEURA·FM radio player. Backend + frontend integration confirmed via network trace and UI observation.

issues: React console warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key' — same segment id appears twice in the segments array because the play loop appends the segment locally AND the 5s refresh() re-fetches the same segment from GET /api/segments. Recommend de-duplicating by id in setSegments or using unique key = `${s.id}-${idx}`.

verification_results.BUG_FIX_1_music_plays: PASS — network log shows GET https://tempfile.aiquickdraw.com/r/c5095323c5d34499a2094a63a2e5c7d1.mp3 returning HTTP 206 (partial content / streaming) as soon as the ♪-titled segment (Light Up The Night — NVRMIND) enters _playMusicWithVoice. music_audio_url arrives from backend as absolute https:// URL already.
verification_results.BUG_FIX_2_speech_intro_outro: PASS — network log shows GET https://autoradio-ai.preview.emergentagent.com/api/tts/tts_*.mp3 → 200 for both talk segments and the DJ intro over music. Relative /api/... URLs are resolved to absolute backend origin URLs via endpoints.audioUrl() in PublicRadio.fetchSegment regardless of hdMode.
verification_results.BUG_FIX_3_playMusicWithVoice_path: PASS — the .mp3 network request to tempfile.aiquickdraw.com only happens if _playMusicWithVoice creates <audio>.src and calls .play(); no console.warn('createMediaElementSource failed') was emitted, meaning Web Audio routing succeeded with crossOrigin='anonymous' set BEFORE src.
verification_results.BUG_FIX_4_backend_suno: PASS — GET /api/suno/status → {enabled:true,base_url:'https://api.sunoapi.org',model:'V4'}. POST /api/segments/generate?kind=music returns a segment with populated absolute music_audio_url and track_meta.status='ready'.
verification_results.REGRESSION_non_music_speech: PASS — talk segment 'Aria Selva × Echo Sinclair' fetched /api/tts/*.mp3 with 200 as absolute URL in default (non-HD) mode.

action_items: Minor: Fix duplicate React key warning in timeline mapping by de-duplicating segments by id (currently id shows twice because setSegments push + 5s refresh both add the same segment).
critical_code_review_comments: PublicRadio.js loop: setSegments(prev => [...prev, seg].slice(-30)) + refresh() every 5s can lead to duplicate ids; consider Map-based dedup.

radioEngine._playMusicWithVoice: audio element is created via document.createElement but never appended to DOM — that's fine for playback but means external tools (querySelectorAll('audio')) won't discover it. Consider exposing engine.currentAudio via window.__radio for easier E2E instrumentation.
endpoints.audioUrl assumes path always starts with '/api'; the .startsWith('/api') check protects it, but relying on string slicing to strip is fragile — a URL join helper would be cleaner.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing DB state (Suno track already ready).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for Suno music playback is verified via network trace: tempfile.aiquickdraw.com mp3 receives 206 partial responses (streaming). Speech mp3s are 200. No CORS/createMediaElementSource errors. Only remaining nitpick is a duplicate React key warning in the timeline (segments list dedup).
